name: The Bahamas: businesses registered for VAT

source.title: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries: The Bahamas, residence

dueNote: VAT returns are due 21 days after each period: quarterly below BSD 5 million of turnover, monthly above.
notes: There is no personal income tax, corporate income tax or capital gains tax. VAT registration is required above BSD 100,000 of taxable supplies. Digital assets are regulated under the DARE Act.
Rule packs are information, not tax advice. The user confirms the percentages; the vault enforces what the user chose.
